user.title: Configure OneTV
user.description: Enter the IP address of the device running OneTV.

zeroconf_confirm.title: OneTV discovered

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to OneTV. Make sure the app is open.
error.invalid_response: Invalid response from server. This might not be OneTV.

abort.already_configured: This OneTV instance is already configured.

init.title: OneTV Options
init.description: Configure integration options. The paired Apple TV lets Home Assistant launch the OneTV app when it is closed (it cannot launch itself). The app name must match the one listed in the Apple TV sources exactly.

data.apple_tv_source: App name on the Apple TV

play_channel.name: Change channel
play_channel.description: Change the currently playing channel on OneTV.

channel_id.name: Channel ID
channel_id.description: Channel UUID, stream id or name. Names are matched ignoring case and accents.

play_movie.name: Play a movie
play_movie.description: Plays a movie from the OneTV catalog.

play_episode.name: Play an episode
play_episode.description: Plays a TV show episode from the OneTV catalog.

send_command.name: Send a command
send_command.description: Sends a raw command to the OneTV player.

no_apple_tv_paired.title: OneTV: no Apple TV paired
no_apple_tv_paired.description: Pair your Apple TV in the OneTV integration options. Without it Home Assistant cannot launch the app while it is closed: `media_player.turn_on` fails and any automation relying on it silently does nothing.

track_failed.message: OneTV: could not change the track: {error}

no_apple_tv.message: No Apple TV paired. Set it in the OneTV integration options so Home Assistant can launch the app.

apple_tv_not_waking.message: {entity_id} still refuses the source change after {attempts} attempts, the Apple TV does not wake up. Turn the TV on and try again.

channel_not_found.message: OneTV could not find the channel "{channel}".

unsupported_media_type.message: Media type not supported by OneTV: {media_type}

go_live_failed.message: OneTV: could not go back to live: {error}

go_live_refused.message: OneTV refused to go back to live: {error}
